about: The same file lives in Pricing_Engine (tests/fixtures) and webflow-sync-server (tests/fixtures). Each service must build exactly `base condition shipping` for every case, so the two always publish the same text. Change both copies together.
base: A solid walnut side chair with a carved back and an upholstered seat.
shipping: Pickup is available in Scottsdale, and we offer both local and nationwide delivery.
